gitCommit.subject: Preserve exclusive adoption copies on current Node
gitCommit.body:
Preserve exclusive adoption copies on current Node

Copy the verified upload manifest exclusively after claiming its directory.
Retain source, collision, SIGKILL/restart and committed-WAL evidence.
Add built-in GitHub browser failure annotations without changing test gates.

Validated 3543 tests, 78 browser cases on two Chromium builds, focused checks
on four supported Node versions and finished-index secret scans.
